scripts.wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p circ-wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/circ_wasm.wasm apps/ui/public/circ.wasm
scripts.examples: cargo run --release -p circ-cli -- examples content/examples && rm -rf apps/ui/public/examples && cp -R content/examples apps/ui/public/examples
scripts.dev: pnpm wasm && pnpm examples && pnpm --filter ui dev
scripts.build: pnpm wasm && pnpm examples && pnpm --filter ui build
scripts.desktop: pnpm build && pnpm --filter desktop tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm build && pnpm --filter desktop tauri build
